text: The current ewsifyConfig test retains the old oauthSettings.scope URL while an assertion message still says the EWS scope should be updated. The assertion checks the value actually supplied; its prose does not prove a permission was added. Proposed manual test-comment rule: make the expected value and message describe the same transformation, especially after a config refactor. The historical lost-write diagnosis remains in the existing scoped lesson. This note is based on source inspection. Tests were not run, and full review discussion remains pending.
title: Verify the final OAuth scope rather than trusting an assertion message
